programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The zoosters think King Julien has caused sweet old lady Gladys to slip and hurt herself, thus cutting off the special treats she brings for them. The rush to judgment condemns the protesting lemur to a mighty swat from the Rump Whomper. As the clock winds down to his unspeakable punishment only one abstains - Skipper's gut inexplicably insists that King Julien is innocent. You should know better than to go against your gut. // Kowalski's dream of attending the giant invention expo INVEXPO have to be put on hold when he's laid up with broken legs. Skipper and the rest of the gang go in his place with the promise to bring him a full report. The injured bird goes stir crazy locked away in the hospital, however, and hallucinates that a dangerous Space Squid is invading! Could this be more than the fevered imaginings of the caged bird?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: On a fairy family trip to Fairy World, Dev convinces Hazel to steal Peri's wand and explore Fairy World. Cosmo, Wanda and Peri sneak into Jorgen's office and use his tracker to find them. Hazel and Dev end up stuck in the Un-Wish Zone, trapped by the Un-wish Dragon. Together they must battle the dragon and find their way back to their fairies before Jorgen finds out! // When band and orchestra tryouts happen at school, Hazel finds herself stuck in the middle of a rivalry between the two. Rather than choose a side, she wishes to be good at all instruments and ends up in both. Exhausted from the double life she's living, she wishes that the band and orchestra had nothing to be rivals about. In granting the wish, Cosmo and Wanda get rid of all music on Earth. Hazel, with the help of the Nmusic Phairy (silent N), must restore music to Earth and end this rivalry once and for all!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: During a visit from Antony, Hazel's wish lands them inside "Rattleconda Racers," a board game they invented. Once in the game, however, they bicker about the best way to play. Hazel wants to stick to the rules they used to play by, but Antony wants to make new ones. When the formidable Rhonda the Rattleconda takes off with Cosmo and Wanda, intending to make them her next meal, Hazel and Antony must confront the tension in their relationship to save them and escape the game! // When Hazel must give a presentation on what she wants to be when she grows up, she is excited to share her dreams of being a geologist! Wanting to wow her classmates, she wishes she could excavate an "out of this world" rock to show them. Cosmo and Wanda poof her underground to find a super special rock, and she does! But in the process, she angers a group of rock monsters and must use her knowledge of geology to win them over, get her rock back, and escape the cave!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: After reading a book by the Twins' parents, Bibi learns about Marsupilamis and decides she wants one. So Mica sends the Marsupilamis to fetch one-they try to steal Rosa's hose but it ends up getting lost, and whilst hunting for it Twister mistakes a Jaguar's tail for the hose. The Jaguar then follows them back home where they manage to trap it in their nest, where Bibi encounters it thinking it's a Marsup! Scared she declares she's sticking to Puppies in the future. // Lunch service at the school canteen is slow and Jade leads a chant to speed up the service. programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: iCarly

Grappling with adolescence, she never aimed to gain fame as a rising star/underground celebrity to kids. As events unfold in the pilot, it all happens by accident when a teacher puts her in charge of the school talent show. She and her sassy best bud Sam turn the audition process into a show, which Carly's tech savvy smitten friend Freddy tapes -- including their hilarious banter and great chemistry -- and posts on the Web without telling the girls. The on-line audience clamors for more, and a pop phenomenon blooms, with Carly and sidekick Sam's regular Web casts ultimately featuring everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora ja Saabas tahavad sõpradega veeliumäele minna, aga vett ei ole. Nad kohtuvad vihmapilve Claudiaga ning kutsuvad ta kaasa, et ta veeliumäe peale sajaks. Tee peal sinna kohtuvad nad mitmete seiklustega, kuid veeliumäe päev saab päästetud. // Dora loeb kaksikutele muinasjuttu ning õpetab neile ravitseva luuletuse konnast. Siis selgub aga, et Saapal ongi konna abi vaja, kuid enne kui konn saab saabast aidata peab ta oma ravitsevad triibud välja teenima. Dora aitab teda selles.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed avastavad imeliku koopa. Barbalib räägib koopa Barbapapade lugu ja kuidas nad muutusid. Barbalastel on elutoas pidžaamapidu. Nad kardavad kapis olevat koletist, seega nad seavad lõkse, et ta kinni püüda.

programme.title: Hr Krokodill
programme.desc: Hr Krokodill muretseb, et ta peab valima oma vana parima sõbra Buzzy ja uue parima sõbra Daisy vahel. Daisy ja hr Krokodilli lihtne puumaja muutub keeruliseks, kui nad proovivad kõikidele sõpradele ruumi tekitada.

programme.title: Leek ja monstermasinad
programme.desc: Leek ja monstermasinad on arvutiga animeeritud interaktiivne sari, mille peaosas on Leek, maailma kõige imelisem Monstermasin, tema juht kaheksa-aastane poiss nimega AJ ning nende seiklused Veosilla linnas. Veosilla linnas ei sära ükski täht eredamalt kui Leek. Ta on võidusõidurajal tšempion ning tänavatel kangelane. Kus on pahandust, seal pöördutakse tema poole, sest kõik teavad, et Leek suudab teha asju, mida teised autod ei suuda. Ta on kiireim monstermasin terves linnas: tal on Leegikiirus. Leek suudab seljatada kõik raskused kasutades oma teaduslikke teadmisi. Kui olukord kipub kitsaks, siis suudab ta muunduda ükskõik missuguseks masinaks ning leida lahenduse parasjagu käesolevale probleemile.

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Mis oleks toredam kui üks kutsu ehitusmasinas? Palju kutsusid ehitusmasinates. Rubble ja tema pere - tädi, vanaisa, nõod ja teised - teevad kõvasti tööd, et nende kodulinn, Ehitajatepesa, oleks üks igati v-auhh-va koht, kus elada.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.desc: Kaksikud külastavad Barbabrighti tuba. Kui oleksin miljardär, siis mida teeksin, et enda unistusi täide viia?

programme.desc: Rubble ja meeskond teevad koostööd, et muuta Ehituslahe laudtee säravaks ja pidulikuks talve võlumaaks. Kui lumepäev jääb Mootori ja Mixi Super oravakeerise plaanidele jalgu, siis Rubble ja meeskond teeb seda, mida nad oskavad. Ehitada!

programme.title: Rubble ja meeskond
programme.desc: Ehituslaht saab esimese hotelli, kui farmer Zoe nõbu Hadley tuleb külla. Aga kas Hadley on uue hotelliga nõus? Pärast matkaraja segadus ajab segadusse kõik, kes lähevad hr Pardikese sünnipäevale, siis kutsavad peavad nad uuesti teele aitama.

programme.title: Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Barbapapa - Üks suur perekond
programme.desc: Barbalapsed tahavad leiutada nagu Leonardo da Vinci. Barbalapsed peavad valima basseini ja rattasõidu vahel.

programme.title: Как у них получилось?
programme.desc: В этом эпизоде \"Как у них получилось?\" Александр Мурашев отправляется в Сингапур, чтобы выяснить, как можно победить коррупцию, узнать правду о сингапурских школах и проверить качество дорог самым научным из возможных способов.

programme.title: Характер: Спортсмен
programme.desc: Во время агрессии на Украину российские солдаты убили более 400 украинских спортсменов. Сотни стадионов, спортивных центров, залов и бассейнов были разрушены. Тысячи молодых спортсменов и детей бежали за границу, спасаясь от войны. Ровно через два года после начала полномасштабного российского вторжения в Украину документальный фильм "Характер: Спортсмен" исследует последствия войны для украинского спорта, спортсменов и спортивной инфраструктуры.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.title: Репортер
programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Алабама - самый южный штат США, не географически, а по духу. Некогда — королевство хлопка, сегодня — провинциальная Америка. Над местными жителями часто подшучивают, но сами они гордятся своим штатом и знаменитым южным шармом. Очарование Америки здесь соседствует с ее самыми страшными призраками из прошлого. История Алабамы - это история рабства, движения за гражданские права и, как завещал ее главный гимн, ежедневого преодоления.

programme.title: Смотри в оба
programme.desc: Проект о новостях и тех, кто эти новости делает. О фейках и сенсациях, о невольных ошибках и сознательных манипуляциях. Мы ищем информацию из разных источников, сравниваем и представляем на ваш суд.

Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Реальное кино
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Life on Tweedy's Chicken Farm is far from pleasant for the inmates; they are badly treated by Mr Tweedy and his domineering wife, and kept alive only as long as they keep producing eggs. Ginger the hen's various attempts at escape have failed due to the lethargy and downright incompetence of her fellow prisoners, but when Rocky - the famous Flying Rooster - crash lands in the farm, she sees the chance she has been waiting for: Rocky can teach everyone how to fly and they can stage a mass break-out. However, the braggartly Rocky is not all that he seems; can he really help Ginger and the others find freedom before Mrs Tweedy hatches her fowl plan to turn them all into chicken pies?

programme.title: Mt. Zion
programme.desc: Turei's family are hard-working potato farm workers in rural New Zealand. A talented musician, Turei dreams of his band being the support act for Bob Marley's 1979 tour. But it's a dream that challenges the traditions and values of his upbringing and will set him at odds with his family - particularly his father, a true man of the land.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: Old-fashioned
programme.desc: One island, 40 inhabitants, two scammers. On a picturesque island in Brittany, lifelong friends Jean-Jean (Didier Bourdon) and Henri (Gérard Darmon, Employee of the Month) find their quiet existence disrupted when one of their fellow villagers wins millions in the national lottery. The pair hatch a plan to befriend the lucky local and hopefully share in the winnings... only to find the winner has died of shock - ticket in hand! Jean-Jean and Henri must devise another scheme. In order to claim the prize, the friends will simply steal the unlucky winner's identity... However, the pair soon realise that to fool the lottery officials in such a small town, they'll have to convince the villagers - who all want a piece of the pie - to back their daring plan. Jean-Jean and Henri are out to prove that you're never too old to raise a little hell in this crowd-pleasing comedy, a remake of the Irish classic Waking Ned Devine. With a winning blend of absurdity and heart, you'll fall in love with the stunning sights of Brittany and its colourful characters. This charming story shows what a community can achieve when they come together (yes, even fraud).

programme.title: Aliens Abducted My Parents and Now I Feel Kinda Left Out
programme.desc: Itsy is new in town and her life seems over until she meets her space-obsessed neighbor Calvin, who believes his parents were abducted by aliens. An aspiring journalist, Itsy decides to write an exposé on Calvin but ends up discovering much more.

programme.title: Vera Drake
programme.desc: Vera Drake is a selfless woman who is completely dedicated to her working class family who love her. He spends his days adoring them, and also takes care of his sick neighbor and old mother. And he secretly visits women and helps them have abortions. Something like that was illegal in England in the 1950s. Vera sees it as helping women in need, and she does it with a smile on her face and words of encouragement. However, when the authorities discover her, Vera's world and family life quickly unravel.

programme.title: Dark River
programme.desc: Ruth Wilson stars in this acclaimed drama from writer/director Clio Barnard (The Selfish Giant), inspired by Rose Tremain's novel Trespass. Following the death of her father, Alice (Wilson) returns home to Yorkshire for the first time in 15 years, to claim the tenancy of the family farm she believes is rightfully hers. There she encounters her older brother Joe (Mark Stanley), a man she barely recognizes, worn down by years of struggling to keep the farm going whilst caring for their sick father. Joe is thrown by Alice's sudden arrival and angered by her claim. Battling to regain control in a fraught and fragile situation, Alice must confront traumatic memories and family betrayals to find a way to restore the farm and salvage the bond with her brother before both are irrevocably lost. Co-starring Sean Bean. Co-funded by Film4. Network Premiere.

programme.title: Helmet Heads
programme.desc: An easygoing bike messenger faces upheaval when he and his buddies are fired; when his girl Clara plans to move to a motorcycle-free island, the messenger forms a debt-collecting gang to win her back.

programme.title: Madame Bovary
programme.desc: Bored in her marriage to a country doctor and stifled by life in a small town, the restless Emma Bovary pursues her dreams of passion and excitement at any cost.

programme.title: Rounding
programme.desc: A driven young medical resident transfers to a rural hospital for a fresh start, but the demons of his past start to catch up to him when he becomes consumed by the case of a young asthma patient.

programme.title: Meet the Penguins
programme.desc: Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

programme.title: Intruders
programme.desc: If you thought you were safe at home, think again! Wild creatures and other pests who should be living outdoors make their way into your house on Animal Planet's new series, INTRUDERS. The series reveals real-life stories of homeowners fighting back to reclaim their homes when they've been invaded by snakes, over-run with rats, crawling with cockroaches and broken into by bears, among other invasions

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Life at Vet University
programme.desc: Documentary series following six students at the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine, as they prepare to complete their gruelling four-year education at one of the most prestigious veterinarian colleges in the world. Known as Penn Vet, the institute is recognised as one of the most distinguished schools in animal research and care, and the course requires the students' full devotion if they wish to graduate as veterinarians. Watch the students as they meander their perpetual studies and put their learning into practice, growing both as people and professionals during the intense, consuming course.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: The story follows the work of the dedicated staff of Gulf Coast veterinary clinic, an emergency animal hospital where patients that require critical care are treated by professionals trained to handle a variety of services, ranging from routine check-ups to extremely complex veterinary procedures.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Dogs: The Untold Story is an amazing documentary series providing us with unbelievable stories, research results and facts about our best friends, healers and protectors- dogs. They have evolved from predators to favourite pets, adored by millions people all over the world. They can understand people and even talk to them, they have been by human's side for more than 33.000 years. Dogs are actually more incredible than anyone has ever imagined.

programme.title: Haunting In The Heartland
programme.desc: Something evil lurks in the shadows of the close-knit communities, idyllic Main Streets and rolling fields of America's heartland. Paranormal investigator Steve Shippy witnessed this darkness firsthand as a child growing up in rural Michigan. Now, with the help of local eyewitnesses and historical records, he's made it his mission to solve these mysterious hauntings and bring resolution to the living and the dead.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

Their mission is to visit the most haunted places in America in order to study and investigate the afterlife and its questionable existence. The team use various equipment during their investigations, such as thermographic cameras, infrared cameras, digital audio recorders, data loggers, motion detectors, and other high tech gear.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: The miners embark for the Red Zone and dive into the rich ruby deposit they discovered last year, but the mercurial weather, brutal terrain and extreme isolation oppose the miners' every move. Even in base camp, the dredge operation starts off with unbridled optimism but soon disintegrates into a mess of poor planning and renewed fear that the potential reward never could make up for the enormous risk of this pricey endeavor. Getting back to the Red Zone after a year of anticipation is both triumphant and daunting. Punchdrunk with the first signs of ruby fever, the miners quickly get hit with a harsh reality: Greenland throws a wrench into their plans, and the beast from within starts to rear its ugly head.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: ICE COLD GOLD spotlights a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before. The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.title: Kindred Spirits
programme.desc: Thrilling American paranormal docu-reality series that follows investigators Amy Bruni and Adam Berry who visit various haunted homes across the country in order to help people who are tormented by the spirits of their late relatives. These families are scared by the mysterious occurences and they will seek help from this amazing ghost-hunting duo. Amy and Adam will try to find evidence of paranormal presence, contact the spirits and provide closure for the featured family.

programme.desc: Paul Beban sets out to bring the truth about sea monsters to the surface. After exposing a US Navy encounter with an unclassified creature in a Caribbean trench, Paul tracks a similar one said to be hiding in the dark depths of Vermont's Lake Champlain.

programme.title: Paranormal Declassified
programme.desc: Paul Beban investigates evil shapeshifters from Navajo folklore known as skinwalkers. Paul tracks the mythical beasts from the heart of Navajo Nation to the infamous Skinwalker Ranch in Utah to Wisconsin, where he captures something unexplainable.

programme.title: Mysteries At The Museum
programme.desc: Documentary series in which host Don Wildman, history enthusiast and adventurer, focuses on interesting and unusual artifacts held in museums, historical institutions, and unexplored archives around the world. Don discovers extraordinary, obscure relics and artifacts, shares their incredible stories, that have either been forgotten or are lesser known, and reveals their secrets, taking the viewers on a spectacular tour through history. We also get to find out why and how some of these unusual objects ended up in the museums.

programme.desc: Featuring a fearless crew on a quest to hunt down chain-rattling ghosts and scary apparitions in anyway they can, Ghost Asylum follows a passionate paranormal team in America, the Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) as they attempt to "trap ghosts" in the country's most haunted abandoned asylums, mental hospitals and sanitariums. Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home.

programme.title: Destination Fear
programme.desc: This paranormal reality series follows explorer and ghost hunter Dakota Laden who partners up his sister Chelsea and best friend Tanner, to travel across the country in an RV and visit the most haunted locations in America -dark corridors of Brushy Mountain State Penitentiary, notorious Eloise Psychiatric Hospital, terrifying St. Albans Sanatorium and many more, as they learn the blood-chilling stories behind this scary places and face their darkest fears.

programme.desc: A British paranormal investigator faces great danger when she attempts to unravel the mystery surrounding one of the most infamous and dangerous paranormal objects on the planet--a haunted doll with the power to harm anyone who lays eyes on it.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal documentary and reality TV series follows investigations of scary locations reported to be haunted by ghost hunters Zak Bagans, Nick Groff, and Aaron Goodwin. Many places with shady past like hotels, casinos, homes, abandoned buildings are full of aggressive paranormal activities and do not let people live peacefully. Each episode begins with the crew touring the investigation site with its owners and interviewing the witnesses. Then the ghost hunters crew set up static night-vision cameras to film what's happening. They use a lot of up-to-date equipment to get any sort of evidence and then based on what they manage to get, they start analyzing and investigating things in order to get to the core of each case.

programme.title: Eli Roth Presents: The Legion of Exorcists
programme.desc: A simple word is all that is needed to lead a demon to your doorstep. All is not what it seems when a pastor's son exhibits signs of possession, and an exorcist's girlfriend becomes the unexpected victim of a demonic attack.

programme.title: Eli Roth Presents: The Legion of Exorcists
programme.desc: This show details terrifying stories of demonic possession from cursed objects inflicting harm to complete human body takeovers. Fighting evil from the frontlines is a legion of leading exorcists from around the country who use their faith to keep the devil at bay and restore peace to those caught in its grasp.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: This series focuses on the dark underbelly of the American mid-west, its heartland. Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death
programme.desc: Evil casts a shadow. That shadow spreads outward for years, even decades, after a crime. It consumes everyone in its path, pulling them into darkness. Can they find the light? Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death explores the endless reach of evil, a reach that extends long after the act of evil itself. This original series highlights the struggle to survive as innocent people find themselves caught in the wake of death and evil.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.desc: Expedition Unknown chronicles the adventures of Josh Gates as he investigates iconic mysteries across the globe. Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Lost Monster Files

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life!

programme.desc: Welcome To Plathville is an American reality series following husband and wife Kim and Barry Plath, and their nine children; Ethan, Hosanna, Micah, Moriah, Lydia, Isaac, Amber, Cassia, and Mercy. Apart from Ethan and Hosanna, who live with their respective spouses, the family reside on a rural farm in Georgia, where the children must abide by Kim and Barry's conservative rules. No sugar, no television, no non-religious music and no video games, the children must follow their parents' strict guidelines, as family life centres around music and God. We follow the family through their daily routines, revealing all the drama that ensues with having so many children.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Dr. Mercy
programme.desc: Get to know Dr. Mercy, the doctor who is changing patients' lives for the better thanks to her deep knowledge and passion. Dr. Mercy takes care of the most bizarre skin cases and makes her patients feel better and healthier not only outside but inside. She tackles giant cysts, rare skin disorders, extreme moles, unwanted female facial hair, acne and what not.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode we arrive in the holy city of Jerusalem to explore what we call the "God Brain." Billions of people around the world believe in a divine being, but how does the "believing brain" work? Is spirituality hardwired or installed in us by a divine Programmer, or is it part of a complex evolutionary adaptation process that has been transpiring for millions of years? This episode is an exciting opportunity to exploit hidden-camera experiments, man-on-the-street encounters, and high-tech laboratories across the globe in the quest to explore the neuro-physiology behind spiritual practice. The games devised in this episode will shed light on our perception of morality, faith, and the supernatural.You will learn that even those who don't practice religion feel an instinctual desire to believe, a desire that Dean Hamer from the National Institute of Heath calls "the God gene." Play along as we engage in brain games that suggest you do believe even if you think you dont!
